name: Haldyn Glass Ltd
tagline: Modest-return glass-container maker with commodity input exposure and no forward catalyst — a re-rating story at best, not a compounder
business_overview: Haldyn Glass manufactures soda-lime flint and amber glass containers/bottles for the food, pharmaceutical, beverage, liquor and beer industries. Long-listed small-cap. ValuePickr thread (56 posts) is essentially dormant, last activity May 2025.
fundamentals_table: Volatile; Q4 FY26 revenue +20% YoY, profit +62% YoY (off a weak base); Q4 FY25 had been flat topline / profit -33% YoY
fundamentals_narrative: Capital efficiency is only modest (ROCE ~11.5%, ROE ~8.9%) in a commodity-adjacent business with real exposure to power and fuel costs. Earnings are volatile quarter to quarter: Q4 FY25 saw a ~33% YoY profit decline on flat revenue from cost inflation, while Q4 FY26 bounced +62% YoY off that weak base on a ~20% revenue rise. No specific forward growth catalyst was identified; the old-project case was a valuation re-rating / momentum story rather than a growth story.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. 52-week range Rs 70-155 — a wide band; the stock roughly doubled off its low at the high before pulling back.
